user.title: Connect your Nee-Vo account
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use in the Nee-Vo app.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Nee-Vo again
reauth_confirm.description: Nee-Vo rejected the saved password for {email}. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Nee-Vo. Check your password in the Nee-Vo app, because Nee-Vo can also report a wrong password this way.
error.invalid_auth: Nee-Vo rejected that email or password.
error.no_tanks: No tanks were found on this account.

abort.already_configured: This Nee-Vo account is already set up.

invalid_auth.message: Nee-Vo rejected the saved email or password.

cloud_unreachable.title: Nee-Vo updates have been failing
cloud_unreachable.description: Home Assistant has not been able to update your tank for over 24 hours. Nee-Vo may be down. It can also report a changed or rejected password this way, so check that your password works in the Nee-Vo app. If it has changed, delete and re-add this integration. This message clears after the next successful update.
